prompt: Real helicopter aerial footage over an African savannah at golden dawn, shot on a gyro-stabilized long lens for a wildlife documentary. The camera drifts forward at walking pace over dry gold grassland: a winding river catching the low sun, scattered flat-top acacia trees, thin morning haze in the far valleys, a distant herd of wildebeest grazing near the riverbank. Natural, slightly muted color; true-to-life exposure with soft highlight rolloff; gentle atmospheric perspective; fine 35mm grain; subtle stabilized-gimbal micro-drift. Absolutely calm — nothing startles, nothing chases. Documentary realism only: real-world lighting and texture, no oversaturated golds, no dreamy glow, no painterly or CGI look, no people, no vehicles, no text, no cuts.
